articles.summary: New integration lets guests order directly from Toast restaurants through Google's Ask Maps feature, fueling discoverability for operators Toast (NYSE: TOST), the global technology platform built for restaurant and retail businesses, today announced an expanded integration with Google that brings agentic food ordering to Ask Maps, a conversational AI feature within Google Maps. articles.summary: Toast (NYSE: TOST) released its 2026 Voice of the Restaurant Industry Survey. Each year, Toast polls hundreds of restaurant operators to get a pulse check on the industry. How are restaurants faring in 2026? What are the biggest pain points? Where do they see opportunity, and how has that changed since last year? What was clear from our 2026 survey from April 3, 2026, to April 20, 2026, of 676 restaurant operators and decision-makers is that restaurants are durable , and they’re doubling down on being busy and effective to achieve their business goals. 1 And the data backs it up: 91% of operators rate their business as good or excellent — matching last year's high mark — with growth and efficiency topping their list of priorities. Read the full 2026 Voice of the Restaurant Industry Survey on the Data by Toast website .
